primitives.name: Live Roster Validation Gate
primitives.verbatim_quote: Live Roster Gate: ESPN primary + Sleeper cross-check, suffix-aware (`norm_name`), fail-closed on any feed error or empty list.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'R_{\\text{roster}}': 'Boolean indicator for valid roster entry', 'E_{\\text{ESPN}}, S_{\\text{Sleeper}}': 'Data feeds from ESPN and Sleeper'}
primitives.assumptions: Cross-checks between ESPN and Sleeper feeds ensure data integrity; fail-closed policy prevents invalid entries.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When either feed returns an empty list or error, R_{roster} = false.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's data validation layer using suffix-aware normalization and fail-safe logic.
layer2.telemetry: Roster completeness rate and feed error frequency.

primitives.name: Frontier Engine Gate Set
primitives.verbatim_quote: 5 Frontier Engine Gates: G1 Live Roster, G2 Provenance & Freshness (Sourced dataclass, age caps), G-Sig 47 catalogued signals, G3 JEV Mandatory (`CERTIFIED` / `CAUTION` conf<=0.70), G4 Real LCB (analytical Wilson 95% on empirical outcomes, BDR-Kelly, SVI, EP baseline), G5 Stamp (`ENGINE_GATE_V1`).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'F_{\\text{gate}}^{(i)}': 'Boolean validity of frontier gate i', 'C_{\\text{conf}} \\leq 0.70': 'Confidence threshold for JEV', 'W_{\\text{Wilson}}': 'Wilson score interval at 95% confidence'}
primitives.assumptions: Each gate enforces independent statistical or logical criteria; all gates must pass for signal approval.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Any gate failing causes F_{gate}^{(i)} = false.

layer2.mapping: Derives from GSI's signal registry and GSE's reasoning trace kernel, forming a multi-layered validation pipeline.
layer2.telemetry: Gate pass/fail rates per signal type.

primitives.name: Independent Edge Decision Filter
primitives.verbatim_quote: `independentEdge.decision == "PASS"` filter: Currently enforced in `generate-signal-slate.ts` on create via `passVeto`, BUT bypassed in `scoring.ts` (book path) which only checks `pricesWorseThanMarket` (`expectedClv < 0`), leaking PASS decisions with expectedClv >= 0.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'D_{\\text{edge}}': 'Decision variable for edge validity', 'CLV_{\\text{expected}}': 'Expected customer lifetime value'}
primitives.assumptions: PASS decisions should be filtered by both edge validity and CLV threshold; inconsistency leads to leakage.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When D_{edge} = PASS but CLV_{expected} >= 0, decision is leaked.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's edge filtering logic and GSE's scoring module synchronization.
layer2.telemetry: Leaked PASS decision count vs. expected CLV threshold.
